header.contentDescription: A precessing spin state on the Bloch sphere, with what the picture does and does not claim

drawTextAnchored.text: every point on this sphere is a state
a direction, and only two answers

children.value: spin is an intrinsic angular momentum with no spinning object underneath it
measure along any axis and you get up or down - never a value in between
a state halfway between the poles gives each answer half the time
